transcript: Disney on Broadway recently invited me to come see The Lion King, and I was absolutely blown away by the puppets. I've always found puppetry to be really magical, but the way that Disney on Broadway has taken this fully animated movie and just brought it to life on stage is next level. And I want to show you a few of my favorite puppets that they use. I actually burst into tears when this elephant walked the audience. She is so beautiful and immediately brings such gravitas to the show. Another one of my favorites, the giraffes. First off, they are impressively 14 feet tall, so they're just a joy to watch on stage. But the way they move, it looks so much like a real giraffe. And the detailing on this costume. And my favorite puppet from The Lion King is Zazu. I think it's because he looks just like Zazu from the movie, including the facial expression. You must see this for yourself, so head to the link in my bio to see The Lion King on Broadway.
classificationReason: Creator was invited by Disney on Broadway to see The Lion King and shares first-hand opinions about the puppets and production quality
